colabfold.install: pip install colabfold[alphafold]==1.6.1   # == pip install stock/colabfold-1.6.1-py3-none-any.whl (same bytes: the PyPI wheel); the alphafold extra carries jax, dm-haiku, alphafold-colabfold

cli.note: the wheel's console script (entry_points.txt); main() parses the flags and calls run(queries=...) (colabfold/batch.py:1743, :2202-2203)

colabfold.note: the wheel's METADATA Requires-Dist (the alphafold extras); every range is satisfied by the freeze

alphafold_colabfold.install: pip install alphafold-colabfold==2.3.13   # == pip install stock/alphafold_colabfold-2.3.13-py3-none-any.whl (same bytes: the PyPI wheel)

pin.note: sokrypton/alphafold carries no commit or tag matching this release; the PyPI sdist is the source instead

image.tested_on: the image environment/Dockerfile builds (Ubuntu 22.04, CUDA 12.4.1 runtime, Python 3.11.5, environment/requirements.lock) — documentation only: nothing reads or compares this line
image.env_note: the ENV block of environment/Dockerfile (the process environment of the tested stack, baked into the image); colabfold/batch.py:4-6 sets TF_FORCE_UNIFIED_MEMORY=1 and XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_MEM_FRACTION=4.0 only where unset, so on this image unified memory is off and 95 % of device memory is preallocated; check_pins.py reports these variables and gates on none of them
image.compiler: no cc, gcc or ptxas on PATH (nvidia-cuda-nvcc-cu12 12.9.86 is a pip package)

weights.source: https://storage.googleapis.com/alphafold/alphafold_params_2022-12-06.tar; colabfold's own fetch URL is alphafold_params_colab_2022-12-06.tar (colabfold/download.py:41)

marker.note: download_alphafold_params (colabfold/download.py:38-44, :70) fetches the parameters from the network unless this file exists

stack.note: the kit's requirements (opt/forward/af2_pallas_flash/README.md:18-21): jax[cuda12] 0.5.3-0.7.x, compute capability >= 8.0; the Pallas Triton lowering ships inside jaxlib, so no C compiler is needed and the pinned image carries none

hardware.gate: compute capability >= 8.0 (kit README.md:19); the constant lives in colabfold_opt/stack.py
